description: Generate a .docx document from Markdown or plain text (params ≤1MiB): headings # to ###### map to Heading 1–6 (Word navigation pane ready); paragraphs keep single line breaks; - / 1. lists render as indented paragraphs with a bullet or number prefix (approximate styling, not native list objects); **bold** and `code` run inline; | pipe tables | become bordered tables with a bold first row (short rows padded). Unrecognized lines are kept as literal paragraph text — nothing is dropped. Limits: 20000 blocks, 200000 table cells, 8MiB output. Returns {content_base64, bytes, filename}

filename.description: Output file name, optional (default document.docx; .docx enforced)

name: make_docx
